c74object.name: evi_algoverb
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. True stereo algorithmic reverb
c74object.description:
evi_algoverb is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_algoverb.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_reverb_library.genexpr
Relatively expensive algorithmic reverb with many tweekable parameters. The reverb is modular, with pre delay, early reflections and late reflections all controllable individually, as well as high quality linear SVF filters in both the feedback path and end of wet path. In gen~ alone (as opposed to the MSP abstraction evi.algoverb~) this is tricky to use as the damping and EQ coefficients are produced externally via the 'evi_svf_eq_coeffs.gendsp' (or equivalent) abstraction, and many parameters are differently named to the MSP equivalents. However it can still be used in gen~ alone providing some plumbing work is done.

attribute.name: decay
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, represents RT60 decay time, higher values create longer decays.

attribute.name: drywet
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, Dry/Wet mix of direct signal and reverberated signal. Dry is 0, completely wet is 1.

attribute.name: earlyDiffusion
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, amount of diffuseness in the early reflections.

attribute.name: earlySize
attribute.description: Set in dB, the relative size of the early reflections.

attribute.name: earlySymmetry
attribute.description: The symmetry of the early reflections. A stereo imager, negative values favour left, positive values favour right.

attribute.name: earlylate
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, mix between the early reflections and the late reflections. If at 0 or 1 the opposite DSP is not computed.

attribute.name: earlylock
attribute.description: Hysterisis of the cpu-mute of the early diffusion if engaged. See 'evi.algoverb~' abstraction for details.

attribute.name: smoothtime
attribute.description: Set the smoothing time in ms of all the internal parameter smoothing functions.
